metadata.title: Directrices de Farmacovigilancia para las Empresas Responsables del Registro Sanitario de un Medicamento o Producto Biológico y Afines (MSPAS, Programa Nacional de Farmacovigilancia)
metadata.edition: "Guatemala 2010" (no month; 1 January 2010 is a placeholder) · 5.3: expedited notifications within fifteen days of receipt; 5.4: serious or unexpected reactions abroad notified; 4.2: IPS within 60 days of the data lock point; replaced by F-FV-g-02 versión 01-2021 (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: PNFV guidance under Acuerdo Gubernativo 712-99 Art. 91; the Acuerdo prevails.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
